115			// Generate or extract request ID.
116			requestID := r.Header.Get("X-Request-ID")
117			if requestID == "" {
118				var id string
119				r = r.WithContext(log.WithRequestID(r.Context(), ""))
120				id = log.RequestIDFromContext(r.Context())
121				requestID = id
122			} else {
123				r = r.WithContext(log.WithRequestID(r.Context(), requestID))
124			}
125	
126			// Stash enriched logger on context for downstream handlers.
127			enriched := log.FromContext(r.Context())
128			r = r.WithContext(log.WithContext(r.Context(), &enriched))
129	
130			// Add request ID to response headers.
131			w.Header().Set("X-Request-ID", requestID)
132	
133			wrapped := &responseWriter{ResponseWriter: w, statusCode: http.StatusOK}
134			next.ServeHTTP(wrapped, r)
135	
136			// Log with enriched logger that already carries request_id.
137			enriched.Info().
138				Str(log.FieldComponent, log.ComponentHTTP).
139				Str(log.FieldMethod, r.Method).
140				Str(log.FieldURL, r.URL.Path).
141				Int(log.FieldStatus, wrapped.statusCode).
142				Int64(log.FieldDurationMS, time.Since(start).Milliseconds()).
143				Msg("HTTP request completed")

191	func (s *Server) handleWebhook(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
192		if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
193			http.Error(w, "Method not allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
194			return
195		}
196	
197		// Validate webhook secret if configured
198		if s.daemon.config.WebhookSecret != "" {
199			sig := r.Header.Get("X-Signature")
200			if sig == "" {
201				sig = r.Header.Get("X-Hub-Signature-256")
202			}
203	
204			// Limit body size to prevent DoS
205			body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(r.Body, maxWebhookBodySize))
206			if err != nil {
207				http.Error(w, "Failed to read body", http.StatusBadRequest)
208				return
209			}
210	
211			if !s.validateSignature(body, sig) {
212				// Log security event for failed signature validation
213				secLogger := log.ComponentCtx(r.Context(), log.ComponentHTTP)
214				secLogger.Warn().
215					Str("remote_addr", r.RemoteAddr).
216					Str("endpoint", r.URL.Path).
217					Msg("Webhook signature validation failed")
218				http.Error(w, "Invalid signature", http.StatusUnauthorized)
219				return
220			}
221		}
222	
223		// Propagate enriched logger into background context (request ctx is cancelled after response).
224		bgCtx := log.WithContext(context.Background(), log.Ctx(r.Context()))
225	
226		s.metrics.RecordWebhookTrigger("generic")
227	
228		// Trigger reconciliation with goroutine tracking.
229		webhookLogger := log.Component(log.ComponentWebhook)
230		s.wg.Add(1)
231		go func() {
232			defer s.wg.Done()
233			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(bgCtx, s.daemon.config.ReconcileTimeout)
234			defer cancel()
235			ctx, webhookSpan := telemetry.Tracer("daemon").Start(ctx, "daemon.webhook",
236				trace.WithAttributes(telemetry.StringAttr("webhook_type", "generic")),
237			)
238			err := s.daemon.TriggerReconcile(ctx, "webhook", false)
239			if err != nil {
240				telemetry.SpanError(webhookSpan, err)
241				webhookLogger.Error().
242					Err(err).
243					Str(log.FieldSource, log.SourceWebhook).
244					Msg("Webhook-triggered reconciliation failed")
245			} else {
246				telemetry.SpanOK(webhookSpan)
247			}
248			webhookSpan.End()
249		}()
250	
251		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusAccepted)
252		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{
253			"status":  "accepted",
254			"message": "Reconciliation triggered",
255		})
256	}

258	// handleGitHubWebhook handles GitHub-specific webhook requests.
259	func (s *Server) handleGitHubWebhook(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
260		if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
261			http.Error(w, "Method not allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
262			return
263		}
264	
265		// Read body with size limit to prevent DoS
266		body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(r.Body, maxWebhookBodySize))
267		if err != nil {
268			http.Error(w, "Failed to read body", http.StatusBadRequest)
269			return
270		}
271	
272		// Validate GitHub signature
273		if s.daemon.config.WebhookSecret != "" {
274			sig := r.Header.Get("X-Hub-Signature-256")
275			if !s.validateGitHubSignature(body, sig) {
276				// Log security event for failed signature validation
277				secLogger := log.ComponentCtx(r.Context(), log.ComponentHTTP)
278				secLogger.Warn().
279					Str("remote_addr", r.RemoteAddr).
280					Str("endpoint", r.URL.Path).
281					Str("event_type", r.Header.Get("X-GitHub-Event")).
282					Msg("GitHub webhook signature validation failed")
283				http.Error(w, "Invalid signature", http.StatusUnauthorized)
284				return
285			}
286		}
287	
288		// Check event type
289		eventType := r.Header.Get("X-GitHub-Event")
290		action, reason := shouldProcessGitHubEvent(eventType)
291		switch action {
292		case "ping":
293			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
294			_, _ = w.Write([]byte("pong"))
295			return
296		case "ignore":
297			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
298			_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{
299				"status":  "ignored",
300				"message": reason,
301			})
302			return
303		}
304	
305		// Parse push event
306		var payload GitHubPushPayload
307		if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &payload); err != nil {
308			http.Error(w, "Invalid JSON payload", http.StatusBadRequest)
309			return
310		}
311	
312		// Check if it's the branch we care about
313		process, branchReason := shouldProcessGitHubPush(payload.Ref, s.daemon.config.ReconcileConfig.RepoBranch)
314		if !process {
315			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
316			_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{
317				"status":  "ignored",
318				"message": branchReason,
319			})
320			return
321		}
322	
323		ghLogger := log.Component(log.ComponentWebhook)
324		ghLogger.Info().
325			Str(log.FieldSource, log.SourceGitHub).
326			Str(log.FieldBranch, payload.Ref).
327			Str("pusher", payload.Pusher.Name).
328			Str(log.FieldCommit, payload.After).
329			Msg("GitHub push received")
330	
331		s.metrics.RecordWebhookTrigger("github")
332	
333		// Propagate enriched logger into background context (request ctx is cancelled after response).
334		bgCtx := log.WithContext(context.Background(), log.Ctx(r.Context()))
335	
336		// Trigger reconciliation with goroutine tracking
337		s.wg.Add(1)
338		go func() {
339			defer s.wg.Done()
340			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(bgCtx, s.daemon.config.ReconcileTimeout)
341			defer cancel()
342			source := fmt.Sprintf("github:%s", payload.Pusher.Name)
343			if err := s.daemon.TriggerReconcile(ctx, source, false); err != nil {
344				ghLogger.Error().
345					Err(err).
346					Str(log.FieldSource, log.SourceGitHub).
347					Msg("GitHub webhook reconciliation failed")
348			}
349		}()
350	
351		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusAccepted)
352		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{
353			"status":  "accepted",
354			"message": "Reconciliation triggered",
355			"commit":  payload.After,
356		})
357	}

359	// handleManualTrigger handles manual reconciliation triggers.
360	func (s *Server) handleManualTrigger(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
361		if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
362			http.Error(w, "Method not allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
363			return
364		}
365	
366		var req TriggerRequest
367	
368		// Validate signature if configured
369		if s.daemon.config.WebhookSecret != "" {
370			// Limit body size to prevent DoS; bytes needed for both HMAC and JSON decode.
371			body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(r.Body, maxWebhookBodySize))
372			if err != nil {
373				http.Error(w, "Failed to read body", http.StatusBadRequest)
374				return
375			}
376	
377			sig := r.Header.Get("X-Signature")
378			if !s.validateSignature(body, sig) {
379				// Log security event for failed signature validation
380				secLogger := log.ComponentCtx(r.Context(), log.ComponentHTTP)
381				secLogger.Warn().
382					Str("remote_addr", r.RemoteAddr).
383					Str("endpoint", r.URL.Path).
384					Msg("Manual trigger signature validation failed")
385				http.Error(w, "Invalid signature", http.StatusUnauthorized)
386				return
387			}
388	
389			// Decode optional JSON body from the already-read bytes.
390			if len(body) > 0 {
391				if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &req); err != nil {
392					http.Error(w, "Invalid JSON", http.StatusBadRequest)
393					return
394				}
395			}
396		} else if r.Body != nil {
397			// No secret configured — read and decode body directly.
398			body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(r.Body, maxWebhookBodySize))
399			if err != nil {
400				http.Error(w, "Failed to read body", http.StatusBadRequest)
401				return
402			}
403			if len(body) > 0 {
404				if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &req); err != nil {
405					http.Error(w, "Invalid JSON", http.StatusBadRequest)
406					return
407				}
408			}
409		}
410	
411		// Propagate enriched logger into background context (request ctx is cancelled after response).
412		bgCtx := log.WithContext(context.Background(), log.Ctx(r.Context()))
413	
414		s.metrics.RecordWebhookTrigger("manual")
415	
416		// Trigger reconciliation with goroutine tracking
417		manualLogger := log.Component(log.ComponentWebhook)
418		s.wg.Add(1)
419		go func() {
420			defer s.wg.Done()
421			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(bgCtx, s.daemon.config.ReconcileTimeout)
422			defer cancel()
423			if err := s.daemon.TriggerReconcile(ctx, "manual", req.Force); err != nil {
424				manualLogger.Error().
425					Err(err).
426					Str(log.FieldSource, log.SourceManual).
427					Msg("Manual trigger reconciliation failed")
428			}
429		}()
430	
431		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusAccepted)
432		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{
433			"status":  "accepted",
434			"message": "Manual reconciliation triggered",
435		})
436	}

package daemon

import (
	"crypto/hmac"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/cameronsjo/bosun/internal/docker"
	"github.com/cameronsjo/bosun/internal/docker/dockertest"
	"github.com/cameronsjo/bosun/internal/reconcile"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

// newTestDaemon creates a Daemon+Server pair for handler testing.
// HTTP is disabled so New() skips creating its own http.Server;
// we test handler methods directly via httptest.
//
// A t.Cleanup is registered that waits for background goroutines
// spawned by webhook handlers (via Server.wg) so that the temp dir
// is not removed while reconciliation is still in-flight.
func newTestDaemon(t *testing.T) (*Daemon, *Server) {
	t.Helper()
	tmpDir := t.TempDir()
	// macOS: /var -> /private/var symlink resolution.
	tmpDir = evalSymlinks(t, tmpDir)

	cfg := DefaultConfig()
	cfg.EnableHTTP = false
	cfg.ReconcileConfig = reconcile.DefaultConfig()
	cfg.ReconcileConfig.RepoURL = "https://github.com/test/repo"
	cfg.ReconcileConfig.DryRun = true
	cfg.ReconcileConfig.RepoDir = tmpDir
	cfg.ReconcileConfig.LockFile = filepath.Join(tmpDir, "test.lock")
	cfg.ReconcileConfig.StateFile = filepath.Join(tmpDir, "state.json")
	cfg.SocketPath = filepath.Join(tmpDir, "test.sock")

	d, err := New(cfg)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	// Inject mock Docker client so health checks report docker as healthy.
	d.dockerClientOverride = docker.NewClientWithAPI(&dockertest.MockDockerAPI{})

	s := NewServer(d)

	// Wait for background goroutines to finish before temp dir cleanup.
	t.Cleanup(func() { s.wg.Wait() })

	return d, s
}

// computeHMACSHA256 returns "sha256=<hex>" for the given body and secret.
func computeHMACSHA256(body []byte, secret string) string {
	mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
	mac.Write(body)
	return "sha256=" + hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Phase 1A: Webhook Signature Validation
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

func TestValidateSignature(t *testing.T) {
	const secret = "test-secret"
	body := []byte(`{"action":"push"}`)

	cfg := DefaultConfig()
	cfg.EnableHTTP = false
	cfg.ReconcileConfig = reconcile.DefaultConfig()
	cfg.ReconcileConfig.RepoURL = "https://github.com/test/repo"
	cfg.WebhookSecret = secret

	tmpDir := t.TempDir()
	tmpDir = evalSymlinks(t, tmpDir)
	cfg.SocketPath = filepath.Join(tmpDir, "test.sock")

	d, err := New(cfg)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	s := NewServer(d)

	validSig := computeHMACSHA256(body, secret)

	tests := []struct {
		name      string
		body      []byte
		signature string
		want      bool
	}{
		{
			name:      "valid HMAC-SHA256 with sha256= prefix",
			body:      body,
			signature: validSig,
			want:      true,
		},
		{
			name:      "valid signature without prefix",
			body:      body,
			signature: strings.TrimPrefix(validSig, "sha256="),
			want:      true,
		},
		{
			name:      "empty signature",
			body:      body,
			signature: "",
			want:      false,
		},
		{
			name:      "wrong secret produces different sig",
			body:      body,
			signature: computeHMACSHA256(body, "wrong-secret"),
			want:      false,
		},
		{
			name:      "tampered body",
			body:      []byte(`{"action":"tampered"}`),

// newTestDaemon creates a Daemon+Server pair for handler testing.

//

// spawned by webhook handlers (via Server.wg) so that the temp dir
// is not removed while reconciliation is still in-flight.
func newTestDaemon(t *testing.T) (*Daemon, *Server) {
	t.Helper()
	tmpDir := t.TempDir()
	// macOS: /var -> /private/var symlink resolution.
	tmpDir = evalSymlinks(t, tmpDir)

	cfg := DefaultConfig()
	cfg.EnableHTTP = false
	cfg.ReconcileConfig = reconcile.DefaultConfig()
	cfg.ReconcileConfig.RepoURL = "https://github.com/test/repo"
	cfg.ReconcileConfig.DryRun = true
	cfg.ReconcileConfig.RepoDir = tmpDir
	cfg.ReconcileConfig.LockFile = filepath.Join(tmpDir, "test.lock")
	cfg.ReconcileConfig.StateFile = filepath.Join(tmpDir, "state.json")
	cfg.SocketPath = filepath.Join(tmpDir, "test.sock")

	d, err := New(cfg)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	// Inject mock Docker client so health checks report docker as healthy.
	d.dockerClientOverride = docker.NewClientWithAPI(&dockertest.MockDockerAPI{})

	s := NewServer(d)

	// Wait for background goroutines to finish before temp dir cleanup.
	t.Cleanup(func() { s.wg.Wait() })

	return d, s
}

// computeHMACSHA256 returns "sha256=<hex>" for the given body and secret.
func computeHMACSHA256(body []byte, secret string) string {
	mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
	mac.Write(body)
	return "sha256=" + hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
}

	tests := []struct {

		signature string
		want      bool

		{
			name:      "valid HMAC-SHA256 with sha256= prefix",
			body:      body,
			signature: validSig,
			want:      true,
		},
		{
			name:      "valid signature without prefix",
			body:      body,
			signature: strings.TrimPrefix(validSig, "sha256="),
			want:      true,
		},
		{

			body:      body,
			signature: "",
			want:      false,

			want:      false,

			want:      false,

			want:      true,
		},
	}
